coordinates_source.ref: David Cantrell's Mathematica notebook UltimateHeilbronn.nb (2007), received September 2026
coordinates_source.note: Original author's arrangement, previously shown only as a reconstruction; given exactly in the notebook.

notes: The optimum is the unique real root of 2060x⁵ − 2332x⁴ + 1064x³ − 240x² + 26x − 1; the optimizer — a reflection-symmetric heptagon with one interior point — is unique up to relabeling and invertible affine maps. Machine-checked in Lean 4 and registered in the Palomar registry (PALOMAR-2026-09-02-000012).
Cantrell's 2007 coordinates (shown) agree with the proven optimum to 1.4 × 10⁻¹⁶.
